note: Credit-load thresholds for the UC-09 consequence check (src/domain/consequences.py). Researched 2026-11-05 from the pages below; every rule stays verified=false until a teammate opens the URL and confirms the quote and number. None of the pages gives an effective date, so effective_from is the date they were checked. Never edit a rule in place: add a new one with a later effective_from. Undergraduate only for now (the transcript parser reads UG rows); graduate full-time is 9 hours on the Registrar page.

rules.message: You'd drop below full-time (12 credit hours). That changes your tuition rate and can reduce your aid; check with the Registrar and the Office of Financial Aid first.
Institutional scholarships are prorated below full-time, and an outside scholarship that requires full-time may have to be returned; ask the Office of Financial Aid.
rules.source: Illinois Tech Office of Financial Aid, Undergraduate Enrollment Policy
rules.quote: Students enrolled less than full-time will be charged a reduced tuition rate, which affects institutional scholarships.

rules.message: If you're on an F-1 visa, going below 12 credit hours needs approval from the Office of Global Services and your academic adviser before you drop, or it may put your status at risk.
rules.source: 8 CFR 214.2(f)(6)(i)(B); Illinois Tech Office of Global Services, Reduced Course Load
rules.quote: at least 12 semester or quarter hours of instruction per academic term

rules.message: Below half-time (6 credit hours) you can't receive Federal Direct Loans.
rules.source: Illinois Tech Office of Financial Aid, Undergraduate Enrollment Policy
rules.quote: Students must remain enrolled at least half-time to receive Federal Direct Loans.
